content.title: Institutes II.3: the corruption of human nature
content.author: John Calvin · Beveridge translation, CCEL
content.note: Sections 3–4 distinguish God's restraint of sin and gifts in civic life from an inwardly righteous heart. Used alongside Romans 3, not to deny the benefit of an unbeliever's kindness.
